Les tests se font avec les utilisateurs finaux, le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Construire des applications métier : front end, back end et API.</p> </li> <li> <p>Intégrer des agents et des assistants dans un processus métier, avec des contrôles humains là où ils comptent.</p> </li> <li> <p>Automatiser des processus de bout en bout.</p> </li> <li> <p>Intégrer un modèle dans un outil que les équipes utilisent déjà.</p> </li> <li> <p>Construire les connecteurs dont le cas d’usage a besoin, par exemple un serveur MCP pour un outil métier.</p> </li> <li> <p>Concevoir l’expérience utilisateur de l’IA : quand une personne valide, comment afficher les sources et l’incertitude.</p> </li> <li> <p>Définir avec l’AI Product Manager les évaluations propres au cas d’usage et les suivre en production.</p> </li> <li> <p>Assumer ce que vous livrez après la mise en production : monitoring, incidents, adoption.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Profil recherché</strong></p> <p><strong>Les indispensables :</strong></p> <ol> <li> <p>Vous avez construit des applications avec un front end, un back end et des API, même si votre expertise est plus marquée d’un côté.</p> </li> <li> <p>Du code testé, relu et documenté, en Python, TypeScript ou dans un langage similaire.</p> </li> <li> <p>Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.</p> </li> <li> <p>Des besoins d’utilisateurs transformés en une première version, puis améliorée à partir de leurs retours.</p> </li> <li> <p>Le monitoring, les incidents et l’adoption font, pour vous, partie du métier.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une aisance à expliquer vos choix techniques à des personnes non techniques.</p> </li> </ol> <p><strong>Un plus, pas un prérequis :</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Une expérience de construction d’agents ou d’assistants au-dessus d’un LLM : appel d’outils, orchestration.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience de conception de parcours avec validation humaine (human-in-the-loop) ou d’interfaces d’IA.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience d’intégration à des logiciels métier, comme un ERP ou un CRM.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience au contact des clients.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler</strong> : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</strong></p> <p>Entre le produit, l’interface et le modèle, le Product Engineer occupe le point où l’IA rencontre ses utilisateurs. Leurs réactions s’observent directement, et chaque version livrée tient compte de ce que les usages ont révélé.</p> <p>Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.</p> <p>Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.</p> <p>Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.</p> <p>Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.</p> <p>Le reste s’apprend sur les projets : conception d’agents, évaluation par cas d’usage, expérience utilisateur de l’IA, avec l’appui des AI Engineers et de la communauté Product Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Product Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).</p> <p>Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme le chapter AI Product Manager.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Processus de recrutement</strong></p> <p>Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.</p> <ol> <li> <p><strong>Entretien RH</strong> (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Appel avec le CTO</strong> (15 à 30 min, à distance).</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Screening technique</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Code review et live coding</strong> (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Cas technique</strong> (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Entretien final</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.</p> </li> </ol> <p>Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Rémunération </strong>: 60 000€ à 70 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 6 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.</em></p> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>Mission</strong></p> <p>De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité.</p> <p><strong>Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne.</strong></p> <p>Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. raw.title: Product Marketing Manager
raw.description:
About Nabla

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

About the Role

The Product Marketing Manager will own how Nabla positions, launches, and drives adoption of the product with clinicians across their entire journey — from onboarding and activation through engagement and retention.

This is product marketing where the message ships directly to the user. You own the narrative for every new feature launch, then own the in-app and email programs that turn that narrative into activation.

You'll define the segmentation, write the positioning, ship the campaigns, and measure whether they actually moved adoption.

Userpilot is in place, but everything around it still needs to be built: the activation and adoption strategy, in-app and email templates, segmentation, cohort analysis, the process with Product Marketing peers, CSM, PM, and Design, and the campaign calendar.

This is a hands-on, highly operational PMM role. We need someone who lives in the tools, is data-driven, can test fast, structure the process, and turn usage insights into concrete positioning and messaging decisions.

Userpilot is the first step. Over time, this person will take ownership of the full communication stack across email, in-app, and other channels. The role works extremely closely with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, and Product Ops.

Nabla serves two distinct audiences, and lifecycle programs must work for both:

  • Self-serve clinicians, who discover, activate, and adopt the product largely on their own. Here, automated email and in-app communication carries most of the relationship — your messaging is the go-to-market motion.

  • Mid-market and enterprise health systems, managed by CSMs. Here the human relationship leads, and your programs must arm and reinforce the CSM — giving them timing, context, and content, never working around them.

You'll design each lifecycle so the right channel leads for each segment. On top of this, healthtech is a highly regulated industry with demanding clients: every communication must meet a high bar for accuracy, security, and professionalism, while still feeling personal and useful to busy clinicians.

Responsibilities

Feature Launch Positioning & Activation

  • Own weekly in-app launch communication for new features, end to end and at a fast cadence

  • Define the positioning and messaging for each release — what it is, why a clinician should care, what changes in their day

  • Design the in-app experience (placement, format, flow) for each launch

  • Validate messaging with Product Marketing peers, PM, and Design before shipping

  • Launch on time and coordinate across the relevant teams

  • Track performance (reach, engagement, adoption) for every launch and iterate quickly on results

  • Stay highly reactive to the product roadmap, turning new releases into clear, well-timed clinician communication

Lifecycle Strategy and Execution

  • Own the full lifecycle strategy across onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention, ensuring each stage of the practitioner journey is intentional, personalized, and measurable

  • Tailor segmentation, messaging, and cadence to the distinct needs of each segment:

    • For self-serve, build automated email and in-app programs that drive activation, adoption, and retention with minimal human touch

    • For mid-market and enterprise, build programs that complement and support CSMs

  • Direct and execute creative strategy for lifecycle channels — briefing, reviewing, and optimizing copy and design for brand consistency and message effectiveness

  • Build and maintain a clear campaign calendar across functions

Experimentation and Analytics

  • Lead a rigorous experimentation roadmap: A/B and multivariate testing of messaging, creative, cadence, segmentation, and value propositions

  • Define and own lifecycle KPIs, building reporting frameworks and sharing regular performance insights with marketing and cross-functional leadership

  • Partner with Data and Analytics on audience segmentation, behavioral signals, and AI-driven insights to enhance personalization at scale

  • Turn cohort and usage insights into concrete messaging and product-marketing actions

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, Product Ops, Clinical, and Brand to align lifecycle programs with broader business goals and the practitioner experience

  • Establish a clear, repeatable process across Product Marketing, CSM, PM, and Design for planning and shipping campaigns

  • Ensure all programs are developed and executed in compliance with HIPAA and applicable federal and state laws, partnering with Legal and Compliance as needed

Operations and Tooling

  • Take ownership of the full communication stack, starting with Userpilot

  • Evaluate and manage lifecycle marketing technology partnerships, recommending optimizations as we scale

  • Build and maintain process documentation, campaign playbooks, and training materials on internal platforms

  • Leverage AI tools as a core part of daily work (drafting, research, iteration) to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making

What We Are Looking For

  • 3-5 years in B2B product marketing, lifecycle marketing, or product-led growth marketing, including hands-on ownership of in-app channels

  • Proven ability to craft positioning and messaging for product launches and to ship it yourself, not hand it off

  • Deep expertise across the full post-signup funnel (onboarding, activation, engagement, retention)

  • Strong Product DNA, with sharp attention to user workflows and the details that shape the product experience

  • Strong strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to translate complex data into clear hypotheses, actionable insights, and business recommendations

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; ability to manage stakeholder expectations, influence without authority, and build alignment across diverse teams

  • Track record of building and scaling programs that drove measurable growth in adoption, engagement, and retention

  • Comfortable in a highly regulated, high-stakes industry (healthtech) with demanding clients, where accuracy, security, and compliance are non-negotiable

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Userpilot and HubSpot

  • Familiarity with Looker, Tableau, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar

  • Experience in a regulated industry: healthcare, behavioral health, or health-adjacent

  • Experience with AI-powered personalization, segmentation tools, or ML-informed campaign optimization

  • Experience marketing to a professional or clinical end user

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: About Pelico Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor. We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones. Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started. This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside. About the Role In your capacity as a Senior DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer , you will be instrumental in architecting the orchestration layer that drives Pelico across all fronts, spanning our global SaaS infrastructure to the most restricted, air-gapped enterprise environments. Your core mission is ensuring Pelico remains effortless to install, manage, and expand, irrespective of the underlying host. Operating at the crossroads of system architecture, product engineering, and field operations, you will tackle intricate technical hurdles and help define the future of AI-driven industrial infrastructure. What You’ll Do Build Design and evolve Pelico's deployment architecture across Azure, GCP, AWS, single VM, air-gapped and private cloud environments, using Terraform, Helm and Ansible. Standardize installation, upgrades and tooling to enable true one-click deployment for enterprise customers. Standardize CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure practices to improve engineering productivity, security and reliability company-wide. Support Pelico's enterprise and federal growth, including GovCloud and FedRAMP readiness for regulated aerospace and defense customers. Use agentic engineering and AI-assisted workflows to automate infrastructure operations, deployment and diagnostics. Run Own production infrastructure (primarily Azure) and internal systems (GCP, OVH — GCP being our main internal tooling environment). Troubleshoot production incidents: load spikes, data-sync issues, network problems, cloud provider outages, security issues and end-of-life components. Build monitoring, diagnostics and runbooks so customer IT teams can operate Pelico independently. Participate in on-call, pushing automation further — target is ~80% automated / 20% manual. Occasional customer-facing support as IT teams deploy and operate Pelico. About You 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering roles in high-growth or production environments. Solid depth in at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS or GCP), with the ability to pick up and work across others — our environment spans multiple clouds. Comfortable with containers (Docker) as the core deployment abstraction. Deep understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability and modern deployment practices. Solid software engineering background, ideally with Java, and an automation-first mindset. Comfortable participating in an on-call rotation, troubleshooting production incidents, and continuously improving platform reliability. Comfortable operating in ambiguity — you enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges without waiting for perfect specifications. Strong communication skills, able to collaborate across Engineering, Product and customer IT teams. You actively embrace AI tools as part of how you work, and adopt new ways of working smarter and faster. Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows for coding, infrastructure automation, troubleshooting or engineering productivity. Nice to Have Experience with Kubernetes and Helm specifically. Experience supporting enterprise or industrial environments (manufacturing, aerospace, defense or supply chain). Exposure to security, compliance or regulated infrastructure environments (e.g. GovCloud, FedRAMP or air-gapped deployments). Experience in customer-facing or forward-deployed engineering roles. What we offer Work on a highly impactful product that users love! Office locations : In the heart of Paris (75011) and Miami, USA. Stock Options: Available for every employee. Hybrid flexibility : 3 days a week at the Paris office Premium Health Coverage : Up to 70% covered by Pelico (Alan Healthcare). Meal Allowance : €10/day worked, covered at 50% (via Swile card). Transportation Support: 50% public transportation coverage or an equivalent sustainable mobility package. Wellness Benefit: Access to discounted subscription plans for fitness, wellness, and beauty experiences through our partnership with ClassPass. Collaborative Environment: We foster a vibrant, growth-focused workplace where professional development and team connections thrive. Your interview experience Intro call with Talent Acquisition call (30 min) Hiring Manager Interview (1h) Technical Test onsite: 1h30 Leadership conversation + founders (CEO/CTO) Offer + References , run in parallel Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Pelico is a configuration-driven, AI-native platform: a field engineer stands up a running factory application by authoring YAML — schema, algorithms, widgets, actions, agents — instead of writing code. The Platform squads build the reusable blocks that make that possible, and we run them as a product: our customers are other engineers — the Solution squads, our Regional Solution Engineering pods, and customer AI teams building on top of us.

You'll lead one squad — the configurability framework, the compute layer, the widget surface, the agent-development substrate (MCP/LSP/harness/BYOM), the integration layer, or the end-user Copilot — owning a capability cluster the whole company builds on.

Your mission

You'll own a platform capability end to end — and ship it yourself:

  1. Build the substrate. Author the framework, SPI, runtime, or AI tooling other squads depend on, and review the rest at architectural depth.

  2. Run it as a product. Own the roadmap, the contracts your consumers rely on, the adoption metric, and the deprecation policy that keeps the surface clean.

  3. Set the bar. Author specs, run the spec-driven workflow, and stand up the eval and review gates that make agent-authored code trustworthy.

  4. Harvest the field. Turn recurring customer patterns into platform capabilities, so learning compounds instead of fragmenting into bespoke forks.

  5. Lead by example. Write the load-bearing code, pair with your engineers, raise their craft, and grow the squad as the leverage you ship earns it.

Your impact

Every Solution squad and every customer deployment is only as strong as the platform underneath it. Own a capability cluster well and you create leverage the entire company compounds on — the difference between a platform that scales and a pile of one-off forks.

What we're looking for

This is a lead-by-example role for a senior engineer who builds platforms other engineers love. You're excited by deep, high-blast-radius problems, you measure yourself by what others build on your work, and you lead by being among the best engineers in the room.

You'll need:

  • A track record of shipping production platform / framework / infrastructure that other engineers build on (SPIs, libraries, runtimes, dev tooling, or AI substrate)

  • Deep, current hands-on coding — we build in Kotlin / Java 25 (TypeScript/React for the experience squads); strong here, or a fast learner

  • Real API / SPI / abstraction-design judgment, with a feel for performance and correctness at scale (up to hundreds of millions of records)

  • A platform-as-product mindset — you optimize for adoption and others' leverage, and you're comfortable deprecating

  • A track record of leading senior engineers by example, not by leaving the keyboard

Nice to have:

  • Running a team as an internal platform (adoption metrics, internal NPS, deprecation, roadmap)

  • Squad-relevant depth — codegen/annotation processors, Kubernetes/IaC/observability, React/design systems, MCP/LSP/agent harnesses, ERP/connectors, or end-user agent UX

  • AI-native ways of working (agentic workflows, eval harnesses, spec-driven development)

  • Aerospace / defense / discrete-manufacturing context

  • French is a plus, not a requirement

If you bring the essentials and a strong mix of the rest, we want to hear from you — we're hiring the person who'll make this real, not a checklist.

What we offer

  • A real ownership mandate over a capability cluster, with equity in a category-defining scale-up

  • Deep, high-leverage problems with real customers and real scale

  • An AI-native engineering culture and a small, elite squad — be challenged, learn, and have fun

  • Hybrid working from our Paris HQ, an international team of 36+ nationalities

Your interview experience

  1. Intro call with Talent Acquisition (30 min)

  2. Hiring manager conversation with the VP Engineering (45 min)

  3. Case Study onsite 1h30 / 2h

  4. Leadership conversation + founders (CEO/CTO)

  5. Offer + References, run in parallel

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Role

Pelico is hiring a Senior Product Manager — Core Platform to own one or more of the shared components that every Pelico product is built on.

Pelico is moving from features built per use case to a platform of configurable components: the data model and the engines that compute on it, the configuration layer, UI building blocks, workflows and actions, and the platform services around them. Solution teams, forward deployed engineers and AI agents combine these components to deliver a use case for a customer. The quality of that base decides how fast Pelico delivers, how well it scales and whether customers trust what they see.

You will own part of that base and run it as a product. Its users are internal teams and agents as much as planners and buyers at customer sites. The exact scope depends on your profile and the team's needs. The role is technical: you need to discuss data structures, APIs, performance and configuration models as easily as user workflows.

What You'll Do

  • Own one or more platform components end to end.   • Make components configurable, not custom. Decide what is configured, at which level (common, solution, customer), and where custom code is still acceptable. Cut the time it takes to deliver a new use case.

  • Design for agents as well as people. Give components clear interfaces so workflows and AI agents can call them as tools, with audit, limits and approvals.

  • Hold the bar on scale, reliability and trust. Enterprise data volumes, near real-time updates, on-prem and sovereign deployments, security reviews. Performance, correctness and explainability are product requirements.

  • Keep the platform coherent. Work with the other platform PMs and with design on shared vocabulary, data contracts and dependencies, so components fit together.

About You

  • Product management: 5+ years as a PM in B2B software, including time owning a platform, infrastructure or developer-facing product used by other teams.

  • Platform judgment: you know when to generalize and when not to, and you can turn down a one-off request while keeping the requester on your side.

  • Data rigor: you can query data, trace an odd output back to its source and size the impact of a change across customers.

  • Enterprise B2B experience: you know what large customers require on security, deployment and change management.

  • Domain curiosity: interest in manufacturing, supply chain or industrial operations, and the will to learn how a plant runs.

  • Cross-functional leadership: you lead engineers, designers and other PMs through decisions without formal authority.

  • Clear writing: specs, decision memos and release notes that engineers, customers and executives understand.

  • Education: a degree in engineering, computer science or a related field.

  • Experience with AI agents, LLM tool use or human-in-the-loop workflows

Nice to have

  • Experience on a platform whose components other teams combine: low-code or configuration platforms, data platforms, workflow engines, developer tools

  • Experience in supply chain, manufacturing, ERP or planning software

  • Background in data modeling, ontologies or large-scale data processing

  • Experience with on-prem or sovereign deployments at enterprise customers

  • Aerospace, defense or industrial customers

Why Pelico

We're building something genuinely hard and genuinely important. Here's what that comes with:

  • Meaningful equity — you're building this with us, so you'll own a piece of it

  • Competitive salary benchmarked to your market

  • Flexible, hybrid work model — we care about output, not face time

  • Alan health coverage — up to 70% covered by Pelico

  • Opportunity to work with some of the world's most complex and fascinating manufacturing operations

  • A team that takes the work seriously without taking themselves too seriously

raw.title: Engineering Manager - Design System (x/f/m)
raw.description:
Your mission

At Doctolib, we're building digital health solutions used by more than 90 million patients and 520,000 healthcare professionals across Europe. The quality, consistency, and accessibility of our interfaces are critical to that mission. That's exactly what our Design System team makes possible.

As Engineering Manager of the Design System team, you will lead the engineering efforts behind Oxygen, Doctolib's design system. Oxygen goes far beyond a component library: it is the infrastructure that ensures design quality at scale and delivers our brand identity consistently across an AI-first development environment. With over 50 designers and several hundred engineers building across multiple markets and product surfaces, your work directly shapes the experience of every user who interacts with Doctolib.

Working at the intersection of Design and Engineering, you will partner with designers, product managers, and engineers to turn our Design System vision into scalable technical solutions that power consistent, high-quality user interfaces across all Doctolib products.

 

What you'll do

  • Define your team's vision, strategy, and roadmap alongside your Product partner, bringing strong technical perspectives to shape and challenge priorities, and take end-to-end ownership of engineering delivery and quality.

  • Lead the technical design, development, and evolution of Oxygen, ensuring its components and foundations are accessible, robust, reusable, and scalable across our products.

  • Champion an AI-first approach, exploring and scaling AI-powered tools and workflows that help designers and engineers build high-quality user interfaces more efficiently.

  • Establish and promote UI and accessibility engineering best practices, working closely with designers, product teams, and our accessibility specialist to drive adoption across the organization.

  • Drive technical alignment across engineering teams, fostering collaboration and ensuring the Design System integrates seamlessly across our web and mobile ecosystems.

  • Coach, mentor, and develop your engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

Who you are

If you don’t meet all the requirements below but believe this opportunity matches your expectations and experience, we still encourage you to apply!

You could be our next teammate if you:

  • You have at least 8+ years of software engineering experience, combined with 2-3 + years of management experience

  • Have experience leading, coaching, and developing engineers, helping them grow while fostering a strong engineering culture.

  • Understand the value of design systems and have experience creating, maintaining, or contributing to component libraries that scale across multiple teams

  • Have a strong understanding of UI engineering principles and experience building consistent, high-quality user interfaces across web and mobile platforms, working closely with designers.

  • Adapt quickly to change, embracing uncertainty and consistently solving problems to achieve meaningful outcomes.

  • Are committed to accessibility and understand the importance of building inclusive user experiences that comply with WCAG guidelines

  • Have proven experience developing maintainable and secure products with a focus on code quality, testing, and documentation

  • Your English skills allow you to have high quality daily interactions with the team. German or French are a plus.

     

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience improving developer experience and driving the adoption of shared UI components and tooling across engineering teams.

  • Have worked with cross-platform design systems, understanding the challenges of maintaining consistency across web and native mobile applications.

  • Know how to implement frontend monitoring and observability to improve UI reliability and performance.

  • Have contributed to open source or maintained internal tools/libraries

 

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

 

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

 

The interview process

  • Recruiter Interview

  • System Design interview

  • Behavioral Interview

  • EM Case study Interview

  • Reference Check

  • Offer!

 

Job details

  • Permanent Position

  • Full time

  • Location: Levallois or Berlin or Nantes

  • Start Date: As soon as possible

title: Head of Strategy & Insights
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>Role Overview</strong></p> <p>WPP Media is seeking a Head of Strategy &amp; Insights to lead the global media strategies for one of the most prestigious global luxury groups in the world. Sitting at the intersection of culture, audience, planning, and insights, you will oversee a talented team to deliver transformative media strategies across a prestigious portfolio of Maisons.<br><br></p> <p>For this critical leadership role, we are seeking an "M-shaped" talent. You bring a broad knowledge of communications, media, and luxury, combining big-picture strategic thinking with the technical fluency to dive into expert topics. You are equally comfortable advising on high-level strategy as you are coordinating specialized teams to turn macro-visions into high-quality execution.<br><br></p> <p>As a trusted advisor to Maisons C-suite stakeholders, you will go beyond traditional media planning to shape long-term brand equity, champion luxury intelligence, and elevate planning excellence across our global network of over 40 markets.<br><br><strong>* Location: Paris</strong></p> <p><strong>* Team management: 5-6 people (Senior to Manager Media Planning &amp; Insights Talents)</strong></p> <p><strong>* Client: Global Luxury group</strong></p> <p><strong>* Language: French &amp; English<br><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities<br><br></strong></p> <ol> <li><strong> </strong><strong><u>Strategy &amp; Planning Excellence</u></strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Team Leadership: Direct and inspire a global team of five strategic planners (ranging from Manager to Senior profiles), ensuring the high-quality delivery of strategic media recommendations across diverse briefs and a varied Maisons portfolio.</li> <li>Annual Media Strategy: Define the overarching annual media strategy for the group leading Maisons, across various luxury categories.</li> <li>Media Guidelines: Define and oversee the creation of media planning guidelines (annual or high-stakes campaigns). Establish their structure and coordinate relevant internal teams (e.g., Social and Search experts) to ensure their successful completion.</li> <li>Planning Framework: Elevate local market planning quality by refining existing planning frameworks and enforcing their adoption, supported directly by the Planning &amp; Insights Capabilities Associate Director.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>&nbsp;</u></strong></p> <ol> <li><strong> </strong><strong><u>Luxury Thought Leadership &amp; Intelligence</u></strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Intelligence Agenda: Define the annual Luxury Thought Leadership calendar; oversee the creation and presentation of high-impact intelligence reports and global webinars.</li> <li>Macro-Consultancy: Partner with Maisons and relevant WPP agencies on forward-looking, long-term prospective topics that extend well beyond pure paid media.</li> <li>Knowledge Ecosystem: Foster a culture of luxury intelligence-sharing, ensuring a seamless flow of insights between central and local market teams.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ol> <li><strong> </strong><strong><u>Tools &amp; Insights</u></strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Planning &amp; Insights Capability: Manage and mentor the Insights &amp; Planning Capabilities Associate Director to enforce the consistent application of WPP Media "hero" planning and insight tools across the entire account network, ensuring data-driven strategic foundations.</li> <li>Global Research Agenda: In collaboration with the Insights &amp; Planning Capabilities Associate Director, define the global studies agenda, overseeing research execution and the delivery of actionable insights to the client.<br><br></li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> </strong><strong><u>Local Market Support &amp; Connectivity</u></strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Global Upskilling: Refine and deploy planning and insights training programs tailored for local market teams and planning resources.</li> <li>Network Synergy: Build influential relationships with top-tier global markets to capture local best practices, maximize global strategy adoption, and elevate localized execution.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Requirements &amp; Profile</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Global Strategic Planning Experience</strong>: 10–15+ years of experience within integrated communications and media planning, with a heavy emphasis on global or multi-market accounts.</li> <li><strong>Luxury Expertise:</strong> Deep, demonstrable expertise within the luxury sector (Fashion, Jewelry, and Watches preferred), with a thorough understanding of the luxury consumer mindset and differences across Maisons and regions.</li> <li><strong>Holistic Comms Thinking:</strong> Proven ability to think beyond traditional paid media, demonstrating an integrated communications planning mindset that connects media strategy with broader cultural and brand ecosystems.</li> <li><strong>C-Suite Gravitas:</strong> Exceptional presentation and communication skills, with a proven ability to engage, persuade, and challenge C-suite executives through strong, well-reasoned convictions.</li> <li><strong>Team Management:</strong> A proven track record of managing, mentoring, and inspiring diverse strategic teams; a natural collaborator and team player.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Agility:</strong> A highly flexible thinker capable of adapting strategic frameworks across a wide variety of brands with vastly different budgets, target audiences, and ambitions.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Department Orchestration:</strong> Proven ability to collaborate with and coordinate across diverse, specialized expert teams (e.g., Social, Search, and Centralized Buying) to align channel tactics with overarching macro-strategy.</li> <li><strong>Language</strong>: Full professional fluency in both English and French</li> <li><strong>Curiosity</strong>: A genuine appetite for working in a highly international, multicultural environment.</li> </ul> <p></p> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to <strong>Be Extraordinary</strong>, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also <strong>Lead Optimistically</strong>, firmly believing in and <strong>Championing Growth </strong>and <strong>Development </strong>for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.</p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics.&nbsp;</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment.&nbsp;</p> <p>Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.&nbsp;</p> <p></p> <p><strong>#LI-Promoted</strong>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: AI Engineer - Full time
description: TLDR; Davis is hiring an AI Engineer to work on the multi-agent pipeline turning raw, fragmented data into expert-grade real estate deliverables. You will make it more reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from the best human teams, then push it past what any human team could do, owning the stack end to end, from context engineering and orchestration to verification, storage and evaluation. About Davis Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis. We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability. We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital , with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end. Where We Operate Early-stage development starts with a chain of high-stakes decisions , each requiring different data, different expertise, and different deliverables. Today, we deliver AI-powered outputs across the full spectrum - site sourcing, feasibility studies, architectural design, investment analysis, financial modeling, dataroom analysis, and more. The Role You will work on one of the core systems behind what Davis delivers. Our agents take raw, fragmented data and turn it into deliverables that real estate professionals use to make high-stakes decisions. Your job is to make that pipeline reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from work done by the best human teams - then push it beyond what any human team could do. You can expect to: Build and operate multi-agent systems that turn heterogeneous data into expert-grade deliverables across real estate development workflows. Own the system end to end : infra, orchestration, context engineering, how the system selects, structures, and injects the right information so agents behave reliably at scale. Ensure production-grade quality , performance, and reliability across every output we deliver to clients. Sit with clients and domain experts regularly to understand their constraints, challenge your own assumptions, and make sure every output meets and even exceeds clients' expectations. Beyond the technical depth, this role will expose you to how real estate decisions are made, how clients think, and what it takes to deliver outputs they trust. You'll develop a sharp business intuition alongside your engineering skills. Key Responsibilities Harness engineering: design and build the system layer around the model - context assembly, tool orchestration, verification, and report generation - to deliver consistent, high-quality outputs at scale. Data ingestion & context assembly: handle messy, unstructured project data from heterogeneous sources and ensure agents have the right context at all times. Storage & traceability: persist sources, extracted facts, intermediate results, report versions, and expert edits. Expert-in-the-loop UX: design and build the review experience (annotations, edits, approvals, diffs/version history, provenance display). Evaluation & benchmarking: build an internal eval harness (datasets, rubrics, regression tests, monitoring) to track agents performance over time. What We're Looking For 1.5+ years building and deploying production software at scale (APIs, reliability, testing, performance). Experience building and evaluating LLM agents / multi-step workflows in real systems. Proven context engineering experience: you've built systems where reliability depends on assembling the right context (RAG over heterogeneous sources, summarization, conversation state, tool outputs). Deep Python expertise (clean architecture, typing, async/concurrency, strong testing culture). Strong experience with databases + data modeling (structured storage, document storage, versioning). Full-stack experience (you can ship a real UI), with a clear backend emphasis . Comfortable building from first principles: we don't want heavy agent frameworks — we prefer a lightweight, well-engineered codebase. Nice to Have Experience operating LLM systems with observability and quality monitoring in production. GIS familiarity (parcels, zoning layers, geocoding). Multi-country product experience (heterogeneous sources, localization, varying rules). NLP background Why Join Us You're joining a team of 9 at the very beginning - where every decision you make shapes the product, the culture, and the trajectory of the company. What you build here will be yours. Direct impact on growth: your work doesn't sit behind three layers of review. You ship, clients use it, and you see the results. Every output you improve translates directly into revenue and reputation. Real-world impact : your work supports investment decisions, accelerates development timelines, and helps redefine how cities are imagined, designed, and built. High ownership : own the full feasibility stack end to end, as the CEO of that part. Competitive salary and meaningful equity in an early-stage company. A small team with high standards - we ship fast and love working together. More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after: Team Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20 , and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis . They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle. Today we're a team of 12 : technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We're small with an extremely high bar . If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need. Why We'll Win Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated. Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts. Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Yet Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability ; parametric tools only check constraints after generation , leading to designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites. Generative AI has the potential to solve this , but doesn't yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. As a result, floorplans may “look” plausible but break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they're usable. We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV. If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Data Center Architect
raw.description:
TLDR; Davis is looking for an architect who has already run data center feasibility studies on their own, and who can answer the question a client asks in front of a site: how many megawatts can this land absorb. We expect three to five years on the data center product, with two or three projects seen end to end.


About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

The data center market is structuring fast, operators and landowners are hunting for sites, and the question they ask is one of capacity: how many megawatts of IT load does this land carry, under what scheme, and on what conditions. We answer in days where the market takes weeks. You will be the person who answers for that number.

You will run a portfolio of test fits and data center feasibility studies, with occasional work on large logistics and industry. Under the supervision of a lead architect, you take these projects from first capacity through to schematic design, and you present them to the client.

The core of the role

  • Establish a site's capacity in IT megawatts, working from the local zoning rules and operating constraints, and set out the assumptions behind it.

  • Qualify the applicable land-use category and the environmental-classification regime for industrial facilities, and derive from them the permitted height, the setbacks and the siting conditions.

  • Draw the data halls at their real grid, fully laid out, with their aisles, their air-handling units and their structural grid.

  • Compose the industrial site plan: service yards, a perimeter heavy-vehicle road, loading docks, retention basins, planted buffers, access and parking.

  • Arbitrate between schemes, one level, two levels or more, while respecting the slab-to-slab height and the zoning height cap.

  • Name the questions to put to the operator: cooling system, density per rack, electrical redundancy, hall dimensions, height.

  • Carry your number in front of the client, and defend it under challenge.

  • Place the project on its critical path: grid connection, environmental permitting, ecological surveys, preventive archaeology.

Contribute to the technology

  • Formalize data center best practice, translating the sizing cascade, the grids and the thresholds into criteria our AI teams can use.

  • Qualify the model's outputs, saying what is right, what is wrong, and on what grounds.

  • Work across the product, tech and real estate teams, inside the tool's continuous-improvement cycles.

Work as a team

  • Take part in project reviews and exchange with the other architects to improve the methods and the quality of the deliverables.

  • Contribute to the team's graphic standards.

What We’re Looking For

  • Education: a degree in architecture.

  • Experience: we count projects as much as years. Three to five years on the data center product, with two or three projects seen across their full cycle. One of them should be a project you carried yourself, from capacity through to permit or schematic design. A background in large logistics or industrial buildings is a valid base, provided you add that data center experience to it.

  • Software: mastery of Rhino and Revit is essential, and AutoCAD is expected.

  • Appetite for digital tools and AI: you do not need to code, but the drive to fold these tools into your practice and push it forward is essential.

  • Speed and synthesis: our clients decide fast, on a number. You need to produce a credible, well-drawn scenario in hours, cut to the essential on ambiguous cases, and know what level of detail serves the decision at each phase.

Domain skills

  • Product knowledge, the sizing cascade of a data center, hall, power, cooling, telecom and logistics, the slab-to-slab height and what it imposes, the rack-and-aisle grid, electrical redundancy, the order of magnitude of a PUE.

  • Applied regulatory fluency, the land-use sub-category and the 2023 ruling that reclassified data centers, the environmental-classification headings and the threshold that triggers a full environmental permit, height and setback rules, no-net-land-take targets and designation as a project of major national interest, rooftop renewable-energy requirements.

  • Buildable capacity, linking a rule to its quantified effect on a volume, and a volume to an installable power.

  • Industrial site planning, heavy-vehicle access, turning circles, fire safety, water management, insertion and edges.

  • Graphic production, plans, sections and diagrams that make a capacity argument legible to an investor.

  • Ownership of the subject, presenting, arguing and defending a number in front of a client who contests it. We are looking for someone who has owned the subject end to end, assumptions, number and client presentation.

Complementary skills

  • Rigor and a sense of synthesis, especially on ambiguous cases.

  • Structuring information, organizing what you produce so that others, human or machine, can use it.

  • An ability to work across the product, tech and real estate teams.

  • A command of technical English, the vocabulary of the sector being largely English-speaking.

Why Join Davis?

  • Take part in a genuine transformation of the real estate profession, and co-build the next generation of feasibility standards alongside a high-caliber technical team.

  • You will set Davis's data center method, and it will serve every project that follows.

  • See your work in every deliverable, and correct the tool when it gets things wrong.

  • Join a young company, where the methods and the tools are still being built, and where your expertise shapes the way we work.

Package

  • Fixed-term or permanent depending on the case, to discuss together

  • Offices in the center of Paris 2e

  • Private health insurance covered

  • Meal vouchers

  • Gym membership covered

  • 50% of commuting costs reimbursed

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:


Team

Mehdi (CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why We'll Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

En un coup d'œil

  • Contrat : CDI

  • Lieu : Paris ou Aix-en-Provence ; hybride

  • Équipe : Métier

  • Expérience : 5 à 8 ans en paie, dont une expérience chez un éditeur de paie ou en MOA paie

 
 

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio, en quelques mots

Le marché de la paie en cabinet d'expertise comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain.

Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio a levé 2,6 M€ en pre-seed auprès de Partech et de business angels de référence. Nous accélérons pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l'accompagnement.

 

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Un logiciel de paie ne vaut que par la justesse de ses règles métier. Qu'il vienne de la roadmap ou d'un cabinet, chaque sujet doit être analysé finement avant d'être développé : règles applicables, cas limites, impacts sur les bulletins et sur la DSN. Avec l'arrivée de nouveaux cabinets et l'extension d'Alassio à de nouveaux régimes, ces sujets se multiplient.

 

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu es l'analyste métier de référence de la paie chez Alassio : tu décortiques les sujets complexes et tu transformes un besoin métier en solution fiable, puis tu t'assures que ce qui est livré fonctionne vraiment pour nos cabinets. Tes sujets d'analyse viennent de deux sources : la roadmap du produit paie, et les cas les plus complexes que nous remontent nos cabinets.

 

🧭 Tes missions

  • Analyser les sujets métier de la roadmap : règles applicables, cas limites, impacts sur les bulletins et la DSN, notamment pour l'extension d'Alassio à de nouveaux régimes

  • Investiguer les cas les plus complexes escaladés par le support : écarts de calcul, anomalies et rejets DSN, régularisations ; identifier la cause et la bonne réponse (bug, évolution ou paramétrage, ce dernier étant pris en charge par l'Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie)

  • Formaliser tes analyses en spécifications fonctionnelles pour l'équipe Tech

  • Construire les cas de test avant chaque mise en production

  • Porter des sujets de bout en bout, du cadrage à la mise en production, avec l'équipe Tech

  • Prototyper si besoin avec des outils d'IA pour valider une approche

  • Faire de chaque analyse une source d'amélioration : transformer les irritants récurrents en sujets produit, priorisés avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier), et enrichir la documentation fonctionnelle et la base de connaissances

 

🔁 Tes rituels

  • Les kickoffs des sujets que tu portes ou sur lesquels tu interviens

  • Un triage hebdomadaire avec Huy Anh, l'Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie et le support : remontées des cabinets, corrections, priorités produit

  • Le demo day de toute l'équipe, chaque vendredi midi

 

🤝 Ton environnement

  • Tu travailles au quotidien avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier), l'Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie, le support, l'équipe Tech et Ludivine (Resp. Juridique)

  • Outils : Alassio, Linear, Notion, Intercom, outils d'IA

 

🗓️ Tes 6 premiers mois

  • À 1 mois : tu maîtrises le produit, le moteur de calcul et le circuit du support ; tu analyses tes premiers cas remontés par les cabinets et ta première spécification est relue avec Huy Anh

  • À 3 mois : tu portes un sujet de la roadmap de bout en bout (spécification, cas de test, recette), l'analyse des remontées des cabinets est systématisée et tu partages ton rapport d'étonnement

  • À 6 mois : tu es la référence métier de la squad Prod ; les sujets arrivent mieux spécifiés aux développeurs, avec moins d'allers-retours, et les irritants des cabinets se résolvent plus vite

 
 

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

Indispensable :

  • 5 à 8 ans d'expérience en paie, dont une expérience de consultant(e) chez un éditeur de paie ou en maîtrise d'ouvrage (MOA) paie

  • Une pratique avancée de l'analyse fonctionnelle : spécifications, cas de test

  • Maîtrise de la DSN : structure, contrôles, anomalies et rejets, régularisations

  • Solide culture des règles de paie en environnement multi-conventions

  • Une écriture claire et structurée, compréhensible par un développeur comme par un gestionnaire de paie

Un plus :

  • Pratique d'un logiciel de paie du marché

  • Expérience d'un outil de gestion de projet produit (Linear, Jira ou équivalent)

  • Aisance avec les outils d'IA ou de prototypage

 

💎 Qualités

  • Le réflexe d'aller au fond d'un sujet avant d'écrire une ligne de spécification

  • L'autonomie pour porter un sujet de bout en bout

  • La capacité à faire dialoguer le métier et la tech

 
 

Processus de sélection

1️⃣ Appel d'introduction avec Hector (COO) : 30 min

2️⃣ Entretien métier avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier) et Hector : 45 min

3️⃣ Cas pratique en direct avec Huy Anh et un développeur : à partir d'une remontée réelle d'un cabinet, qualifier le besoin et poser les grandes lignes d'une spécification et de ses cas de test : 1 h

4️⃣ Rencontre avec l'équipe : 1 h

👉 Le processus se termine par des prises de référence.

 
 

Ce que nous offrons

 

👊 Une mission unique

Être au cœur du produit paie d'un logiciel nouvelle génération, voir tes analyses devenir des fonctionnalités et rester au contact direct des cabinets.

 

🎁 Rémunération et avantages

  • 💰 Rémunération fixe de 60 à 75K€ selon l'expérience + BSPCE

  • 🏥 Mutuelle Alan

  • 🍽️ Carte Swile (titres-restaurant)

  • 💻 Matériel informatique haut de gamme (MacOS, écran incurvé)

  • 🏡 Télétravail régulier possible

  • 🤓 Offsites d'équipe réguliers (un par trimestre en moyenne)

Rattachement : Head of Product

À noter : Merci de noter : ce poste est basé en France, vous devez y résider ou envisager de vous y installer, et il nécessite un droit de travail existant dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous étudions cette possibilité poste par poste, alors n’hésitez pas à consulter régulièrement notre site carrières pour découvrir de futures opportunités.

Le français et l’anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous remercions de soumettre votre CV en anglais.

À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est la plateforme d’intelligence énergétique qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les entreprises de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée au quotidien.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que tu feras

Tu es responsable des résultats de ton produit et tu donnes aux équipes design et ingénierie une vision claire des priorités et du périmètre.

  • Travailler avec l’équipe qui construit notre solution de centre de contact et le Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE), au service d’ENGIE France

  • Définir la stratégie produit et la roadmap Customer Care pour les clients de Kaluza en France, en équilibrant réutilisation du Global Core et besoins de localisation

  • Construire notre suite d’outils pour le centre de contact, dont le CCaaS (Contact Centre as a Service) et le Case Management, pour des conversations efficaces et à forte valeur

  • Utiliser les dernières technologies d’IA pour automatiser et personnaliser l’expérience client, et porter les outils de productivité des agents

  • Être l’interlocuteur produit senior de nos clients (comme ENGIE) : animer des ateliers et traduire leurs besoins en capacités scalables

  • Piloter les équipes transverses (ingénierie, design, data, commercial) pour une livraison efficace, en levant les blocages et les dépendances

  • Définir et suivre les indicateurs clés du centre de contact (AHT, FCR, CSAT, NPS) pour obtenir des gains mesurables sur le coût du service

Ce que tu apportes

Idéalement, tu as :

  • Une solide expérience de leadership produit en SaaS entreprise, au sein d’organisations produit agiles

  • Une connaissance approfondie des opérations de centre de contact et des workflows des agents, et de l’enthousiasme pour l’automatisation par l’IA (voicebots, agent assist)

  • Une expérience avec des clients entreprise français et une bonne compréhension des enjeux de localisation (langue, réglementation)

  • De l’aisance avec les parties prenantes au niveau exécutif et la capacité d’arbitrer entre rapidité et valeur à long terme

  • Une approche orientée data : tu t’appuies sur les métriques opérationnelles pour évaluer la performance produit et progresser en continu

  • Un parcours dans la vente d’énergie ou les utilities (un vrai plus !)

Nos valeurs

Cinq valeurs guident notre façon de travailler chez Kaluza :

  • Jouer pour gagner : Une fierté collective à décarboner l’énergie à grande échelle.

  • Résoudre le vrai problème : Aller à l’essentiel dans la complexité pour viser des résultats concrets.

  • Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole.

  • Assumer le résultat : Une responsabilité totale, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego.

  • Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue.

Nos avantages

  • Finance & assurances : Prime discrétionnaire, mutuelle santé Alan, prévoyance décès/invalidité x3 via Alan, et cotisations de Sécurité sociale standard (retraite, allocations familiales, assurance chômage)

  • Indemnités : Remboursement de 50 % des frais de transport, indemnité télétravail de 200 € et budget formation de 150 €

  • Congés & flexibilité : 25 jours de congés + jours fériés + RTT, congé Moments That Matter (Compassionate Leave), deux jours de bénévolat rémunérés, travail flexible et possibilité de congé sabbatique

Viens comme tu es

Nous voulons rencontrer des personnes de tous les horizons. Plus nous sommes inclusifs, meilleur sera notre travail, et nous reconnaissons les talents sur le mérite et le potentiel. Si le poste t’enthousiasme mais que tu ne coches pas toutes les cases, nous serions quand même ravis d’échanger avec toi.

Suivre l’adoption et la stabilité opérationnelle pendant l’hypercare, analyser les causes racines de tout écart par rapport aux critères d’acceptation, et convenir avec ENGIE des actions correctives. Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

What you’ll do

  • Own UX strategy for our EU programme end to end, with real judgement over what to prioritise and how, as the market and the team's shape itself still takes form

  • Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and Data on the ground locally, including wider teams and client-side engineers,bringing user needs into decisions from the start, not added on afterward

  • Use our established research methods to bring real insight into your own design work, and feed what you learn locally back into the wider team's shared understanding

  • Lead and grow two designers based in London, building one genuinely connected team across EU and the UK from early on

  • Shape how local work becomes part of our shared platform and design system, so what you build here compounds for every client after, not just this one

  • Build directly in code where useful, using AI-assisted tools to prototype or ship small front-end changes yourself, closing the gap between design and delivery

  • Go beyond representing UX, be an active voice in the trade-offs between PMs and Design, holding the right balance between client-specific needs and our global approach, including directly with clients and stakeholders in workshops, showcases, and pre-sales conversations across the EU market

  • Help define what design leadership looks like across a genuinely distributed function, UK, EU, and Australia, while it's still being built

What you’ll bring

Ideally you’ll have/be

  • A track record owning UX strategy and delivery end to end for a complex, multi-stakeholder product, ideally in a regulated or operationally complex industry

  • Experience designing in B2B or B2B2C environments, for professional, repeat users rather than casual consumers

  • Direct experience managing or mentoring other designers, comfortable leading a small team while still doing hands-on design work yourself

  • Experience working from, and contributing back to, a shared platform or design system, not just consuming one

  • Comfort working close to code, confident using AI-assisted development tools (such as Claude Code) to go from design to a working interface yourself

  • A genuine appetite for building something from an early stage, comfortable with ambiguity that comes with shaping a team and a market presence, not just operating inside one already settled

Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)

  • Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund

  • Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility
