raw.description:
About the Role
Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach.

We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting.

Why this is interesting

  • Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments.

  • An open problem: Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users.

  • Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure: Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities

  • Publishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan.

  • Compute: GPU resources are available for training and experimentation.

What You'll Do

  • Bring global flood models to the local scale

  • Take state-of-the-art hydrological ML models (LSTMs, Transformers) trained on large-sample datasets and adapt them to the catchments our customers care about.

  • Use our own sensor data alongside public gauge, reanalysis and radar data to fine-tune and validate those models locally.

  • Tackle prediction in ungauged and data-scarce basins through transfer learning and regionalisation.

  • Own hydrological modelling end to end: set the technical direction, decide when to adapt pre-trained models or train our own, and lead the work from experimentation through validation to production.

  • Work as one modelling team

  • Make practical trade-offs between forecast accuracy, model complexity and development effort to build a reliable product that meets customer needs.

  • Work side by side with our hydrologist specialising in rainfall radar and nowcasting to directly integrate rainfall nowcasts into your flood models.

  • Work with software engineers to put models into production and monitor their performance.

  • Identify and test advances in ML flood forecasting, turning promising research into more accurate and reliable forecasts for our customers.

  • Stay close to the real world

  • We believe the best modellers understand the world behind their models. We encourage you to join field deployments and customer conversations to build that understanding firsthand.

  • You are an opinionated contributor to key technical decisions.

Who You Are

  • You’ve built and validated hydrological ML models across many catchments and have experience taking modelling work into real-world use.

  • You combine scientific rigour with product judgement: you test assumptions, understand uncertainty and focus on improvements that matter to customers.

  • You take ownership from an open question to a working solution. You set priorities, make decisions and keep moving without waiting for perfect information.

  • You care deeply about the quality of your work. You dig into why models fail, follow problems through and stay invested in how your forecasts perform after deployment.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and in person, can explain your reasoning and trade-offs, and work closely with people across hydrology, software, hardware and field operations.

Technical Requirements

  • Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning ML streamflow or flood models across many catchments at once (regional, continental or global), for example on CAMELS or Caravan. Experience with single-catchment models alone is not sufficient.

  • Experience transferring such models to new or data-scarce catchments through fine-tuning, regionalisation, or prediction in ungauged basins.

  • Strong understanding of rainfall-runoff processes and the limitations of hydrological observations and input data.

  • Experience validating models across unseen catchments and time periods, including assessing flood-peak magnitude, timing and predictive uncertainty.

  • Strong Python skills, with experience writing maintainable code for data processing, modelling and reproducible experiments.

  • Practical depth in deep learning for time series, including developing, training and debugging models in PyTorch or a comparable framework.

  • MSc or PhD in hydrology, water resources, atmospheric sciences, machine learning, or equivalent.

Nice to Have

  • Publications or open-source work on large-sample hydrology, transfer learning, or ungauged-basin prediction.

  • Experience with NeuralHydrology, ERA5 or similar global forcing datasets.

  • Experience with sub-daily or event-based flood modelling.

  • Experience processing large hydrometeorological datasets with tools such as xarray and Dask, and formats such as Zarr.

  • Previous early startup experience.

Role Details

  • Contract: Permanent, full-time (100% FTE).

  • Start date: immediately

  • Reports to: CTO.

  • Compensation: Commensurate with experience + equity

  • Growth: a key early hire with the opportunity to shape Riverkin's flood modelling as the team grows.

  • Location: Four days per week in our Zurich office and one day working from home.

  • Work authorisation: Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit, is required.

  • Working language: English. German is not required.

About Riverkin
We are a well-capitalized Swiss startup building real-time sensing and data infrastructure for rivers. Our own field-deployed sensors collect live water-level and sediment data, while our platform turns that data into decision-ready insights for customers. We work directly with the hydropower sector, where predicting flash floods is needed for daily operations. As we prove ourselves in this field, we will move towards the first responders market. We are a small, hands-on team working across hydrology, hardware, field engineering, software and market development.

Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. A minimum of three years of industry or research experience, with PhD experience applicable. Strong deep learning fundamentals including supervised learning, self-supervised learning, Transformer-based architectures, policy optimization algorithms, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques (including Diffusion Models). Proven experience in developing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models or large-scale generalist robot models (e.g., RT-2, Octo, etc.). Strong background in robotics including autonomy, navigation. Experience with deploying artificial neural networks on hardware platforms. Ability to prototype algorithms and train deep neural networks in Python (Pytorch) Get some bonus points PhD degree in Robotics, Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning or a similar discipline, or an equivalent amount of research experience. Publications at top-tier conferences. Experience in managing a software team. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale.

Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. By combining custom robot hardware, onboard autonomy, and cloud-based coordination, RIVR, part of Amazon is building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last-mile delivery


Job Description
 
Our fleet of delivery robots operates globally today, generating vast amounts of robotic real-world data. By utilizing state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, large-scale generalist models (like Transformers), generative AI, and similar methods, we can leverage this pool of data to significantly enhance its autonomy, navigation, and manipulation skills. In this role, you will develop multi-modal models that enable robots to autonomously generate actions from demonstrations, real-time sensor data, and natural language commands. We are seeking an expert in VLA models, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques with a deep knowledge of supervised, and self-supervised learning algorithms. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI we invite you to join us in shaping the future of intelligent robotics.
 
 

What you’ll be doing
  • Develop and implement cutting-edge Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, generalist robot transformers, and imitation learning algorithms (e.g., diffusion policies) to enable robots to autonomously execute complex tasks.
  • Design, test, and refine your algorithms to meet the demands of complex real-world autonomy and navigation tasks, with a focus on spatial reasoning and generalization.
  • Streamline the data collection and training workflow to efficiently expand model capabilities with new tasks and data sources.
  • Collaborate with the reinforcement learning team to innovate methods that leverage both simulated and real-world data.
  • Optimize and distill networks for real-time deployment on the edge (e.g. Nvidia Jetson Thor).
  • Build, lead and mentor an exceptional team of software engineers.
  • Provide expert guidance to product managers and executives for strategic decision-making.
  • Create and maintain documentation, guidelines, and best practices to streamline knowledge sharing.

    • What you must have
  • Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field such as Engineering, Robotics, or Machine Learning.
  • A minimum of three years of industry or research experience, with PhD experience applicable.
  • Strong deep learning fundamentals including supervised learning, self-supervised learning, Transformer-based architectures, policy optimization algorithms, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques (including Diffusion Models).
  • Proven experience in developing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models or large-scale generalist robot models (e.g., RT-2, Octo, etc.).
  • Strong background in robotics including autonomy, navigation.
  • Experience with deploying artificial neural networks on hardware platforms.
  • Ability to prototype algorithms and train deep neural networks in Python (Pytorch)

    • Get some bonus points
  • PhD degree in Robotics, Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning or a similar discipline, or an equivalent amount of research experience.
  • Publications at top-tier conferences.
  • Experience in managing a software team.
  • Ability to write production-level code in modern C++
    • RIVR, part of Amazon is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that values every perspective. If you’re passionate about driving innovation in robotics and creating meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply and bring your unique self to our team.
     
    We believe the best work is done when collaborating and therefore require in-person presence in our office locations.

Für einen führenden Schweizer Finanzdienstleister suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior Software Engineering Platform Engineer – Spec-Driven Development.

Im Zentrum der Rolle steht nicht der Betrieb eines einzelnen Tools, sondern der Aufbau einer modernen Engineering-Plattform und Arbeitsweise: Anforderungen und Spezifikationen sollen künftig so strukturiert, versioniert und technisch nutzbar gemacht werden, dass daraus unterstützt durch moderne AI- und Engineering-Werkzeuge möglichst effizient Code, Tests und weitere Software-Artefakte entstehen können.

Heute werden Anforderungen unter anderem in Polarion ALM geführt. Künftig soll daraus schrittweise eine durchgängige, Spec-Driven Engineering-Toolchain entstehen – von Requirement und Spezifikation über Implementierung und Testing bis hin zu Deployment und Traceability.

Dabei arbeitest du mit zahlreichen Delivery Teams, Architekten, Business Analysten und weiteren Engineering-Rollen zusammen und gestaltest aktiv mit, wie moderne Softwareentwicklung im Unternehmen künftig funktioniert.

  • Du gestaltest den Aufbau einer modernen Spec-Driven Development Plattform und entwickelst die dazugehörige Engineering-Toolchain weiter.

  • Du entwickelst Konzepte und technische Lösungen, um bestehende Anforderungen aus klassischen Requirements-Management-Systemen in strukturierte, versionierbare und maschinenlesbare Spezifikationen zu überführen.

  • Du verbindest Requirements, Spezifikationen, Architekturvorgaben, Code, Tests und Deployment zu einem möglichst durchgängigen Engineering-Prozess.

  • Du entwickelst Integrationen, Automatisierungen und Plattform-Komponenten entlang des Software Delivery Lifecycles.

  • Du evaluierst und integrierst moderne AI-gestützte Engineering-Werkzeuge und Coding Agents in bestehende Entwicklungsprozesse.

  • Du entwickelst Prototypen und Referenzimplementierungen, insbesondere im Umfeld von Java und Spring Boot.

  • Du gestaltest Standards und Best Practices für Spezifikationen, APIs, Testing, Softwarequalität und Developer Experience.

  • Du arbeitest an einer nachvollziehbaren End-to-End Traceability von der Anforderung bis zum produktiven Einsatz.

  • Du unterstützt Delivery Teams dabei, Spec-Driven Development und AI-gestützte Engineering-Praktiken in ihre tägliche Arbeit zu integrieren.

  • Du bringst dich aktiv in Architektur-, Tooling- und Technologieentscheide ein und hilfst, aus ersten Prototypen robuste Enterprise-Lösungen zu entwicke


  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Senior Software Engineer, Platform Engineer, Tech Lead, Software Architect oder in einer vergleichbaren technischen Rolle.

  • Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis moderner Softwarearchitekturen.

  • Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit Java und Spring Boot.

  • Gute Kenntnisse in den Bereichen REST APIs, Testing, Git, CI/CD und Software Delivery.

  • Erfahrung mit dem Aufbau von Engineering-Toolchains, Developer Platforms, Automatisierungen oder vergleichbaren Plattformlösungen.

  • Verständnis für Requirements Engineering, Softwarearchitektur und die Verbindung zwischen Spezifikation, Implementierung und Testing.

  • Interesse oder praktische Erfahrung mit AI-assisted Software Engineering, Coding Agents und modernen Entwicklerwerkzeugen.

  • Erfahrung mit Enterprise-Landschaften und geschäftskritischen Anwendungen.

  • Erfahrung mit Requirements-Management- oder ALM-Systemen wie Polarion ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein, analytisches Denken und Freude daran, neue Engineering-Ansätze praktisch umzusetzen.

  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

  • Administrative Rahmenbedingung:

  • Asap zu 80-100%

title: GTM Financial Services Director
description: GTM Director We're looking for a commercially driven Go-To-Market leader to own how Treatwell takes its Financial Services products to market across Europe. Working closely with our sales teams and leaders, and with Product, you'll turn our roadmap into revenue, with a particular focus on growing our financial services product line.  At Treatwell we don't just sell software: we help Europe's best salons and spas digitalise their business, grow their revenue and improve the experience they offer their clients. You'll be the strategic owner of go-to-market for Treatwell across Europe. With a strong commercial mindset and a highly collaborative approach, you'll define how we position, price, package and launch our products, and partner with Sales to turn them into real, measurable revenue. You will be responsible for: Commercial go-to-market strategy: Own and lead Treatwell's European go-to-market strategy for its new suite of Financial Services products, defining target segments, positioning, pricing, packaging and commercial priorities, with a clear focus on revenue growth. Financial services revenue: Own and lead projects that drive revenue for the financial services product line, from payments to new financial solutions, setting clear targets and taking accountability for results. Sales partnership: Work closely with our sales teams and sales leaders across markets to shape commercial plans and targets, and turn go-to-market strategy into pipeline, deals and revenue. Sales enablement & playbooks: Build scalable playbooks, pricing guidance, sales narratives and training that help local market teams sell our products and drive adoption on the ground. Product launches: Partner with Product to bring new products and features to market, from validation and pilots through to full European rollout, bringing the commercial and customer perspective into the roadmap. Product-led growth: Alongside our sales teams, build in-app and self-serve sales motions that help adoption and revenue scale efficiently. Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Product, Supply, Finance, Operations, Legal and local market teams to embed payments into acquisition, onboarding, account management and retention. Strategy into execution: Translate strategy into clear execution plans with owners, timelines and KPIs, proactively removing blockers and driving accountability across teams that don't report directly into the role. Commercial performance & optimisation: Track and drive adoption, revenue and margin across markets, using data and customer insight to optimise pricing, packaging and the sales funnel. Stripe partnership: Manage Treatwell's strategic partnership with Stripe, acting as the senior commercial point of contact and aligning joint go-to-market plans and growth priorities. About you Proven experience in go-to-market, commercial strategy or sales strategy roles within a fast-growing digital or tech company (marketplaces, SaaS, delivery, fintech or similar) Strong commercial focus, with a track record of owning revenue targets and driving measurable growth Multi-market experience is a must: you've worked closely with sales teams and sales leadership across multiple markets Experience leading commercial strategy across multiple markets, ideally in a central or group-level role Strong analytical skills and confidence building business cases, commercial models and senior leadership updates Excellent stakeholder management and the ability to influence and drive accountability without direct authority Exposure to payments, fintech or embedded finance products is a plus About Treatwell We're a team of 800+ people working every day to transform the beauty industry across Europe. We've built the leading salon management software, connected to Europe's number one marketplace, helping thousands of professionals run and grow their business. The numbers speak for themselves: Over 95,000 partner salons Present in 14 countries More than 23.5 million bookings every year And the best is yet to come. If you want to join an international, innovative and fast-growing company where your work has a real, visible impact... join us! We’ll treat you with: 💰Compensation: A competitive base salary and bonus package. 🌍Location & flexibility: Based in London, Milan or Amsterdam, working closely with teams across all our European markets. 💻Work tools: All the tools and technology you need to do your best work. 🚀Impact: A rare opportunity to build and own a new growth engine for Treatwell from the ground up. Salary : €90K – €140K (depending on experience) Equal opportunities At Treatwell we're committed every day to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace, built on mutual respect and valuing everyone's uniqueness. title: Campaign Analyst
description: Onze missie is helder: beter eten voor meer mensen bereikbaar maken. Als Campaign Analyst in het Customer Retention team speel je hierin een cruciale rol door onze klanten beter vast te houden. Jij zorgt ervoor dat we al onze verhalen, over al onze producten, op de juiste manier aan de juiste klant vertellen. Je bent continu, datagedreven op zoek naar verbetering; zodat we het volgende verhaal nóg beter vertellen. Wat je gaat doen Onze retentiestrategie wordt steeds geavanceerder. We sturen niet simpelweg 'een korting' naar alle klanten maar werken met gelaagde acties, inspirerende verhalen en gepersonaliseerde extra’s. Enerzijds ben jij de analytische drijfkracht achter de executie van onze campagnes. Je bouwt, beheert en verbetert de analytische tooling en dashboards zodat we kunnen blijven leren. Daarmee creëer je begrip van - en grip op - de commerciële impact van campagnes, en alle onderliggende onderdelen (zoals kanaalstrategie, product-samenstelling of klantdoelgroep). Vervolgens vertaal je de verworven inzichten effectief naar succesfactoren, verbeteringstrajecten en/of toekomstige experimenten. Anderzijds werk je inhoudelijk mee. Je bepaalt samen met de Campaign Specialist welk aanbod naar welke klanten gaat, via welk kanaal en met welke verwachting en zet je ook (nieuwe) acties zelf op. Een aantal van jouw verantwoordelijkheden: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de performance van campagnes. Je analyseert de impact, en je gebruikt inzichten om toekomstige campagnes te verbeteren, zodat we kunnen blijven innoveren in onze retentiestrategie. Je werkt actief mee met het team: je levert niet alleen de inzichten, maar bent ook zelf verantwoordelijk voor de implementatie van campagnes. Je bepaalt en draait de experimentagenda: welke hypotheses testen we over aanbod, doelgroep en kanaal, en wat leren we ervan? Je bouwt, onderhoudt en verbetert zelf de datamodellen (SQL/dbt) en dashboards (Data Studio) waarop het team stuurt. Dit ben jij Je hebt een afgeronde WO of HBO-opleiding op zak. Je hebt 2-5 jaar ervaring met marketing (intelligence) en data/business analytics. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands. Je bent analytisch sterk en je werkt datagedreven en gestructureerd. Je kunt vloeiend SQL, hebt ervaring met het maken van dashboards en datamodellen en je gebruikt graag AI-tools om je werk efficiënter te maken. Ervaring met dbt is een pré. Je hebt ervaring met A/B-tests, holdout-tests en hypothese gedreven werken. Je hebt commercieel gevoel: je denkt net zo graag mee over het aanbod als over de cijfers erachter. Je bent een sterke sparringpartner: je daagt collega’s uit met data en laat je zelf ook uitdagen. Je bent kritisch, hands-on en niet bang om de status quo uit te dagen. Wat wij bieden Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem. 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden. Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen. Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp. Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL. Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University. Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven. Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor. Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen. En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten. Onze selectieprocedure Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd. This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with professionals who are the backbone of global capital markets, deliver exceptional service, and build a thriving community for our customers. About DataSnipper

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

For our Customer Success teams, this is where things get exciting.

Alwin has just launched, demand is growing, and we're expanding into new markets and segments. With a product customers already rely on, there's a huge opportunity to make your mark.

 

What You Will Do

 

  • Act as a Trusted Advisor: Serve as a strategic partner to key stakeholders including Audit Partners and Managers, Controllers, Finance Directors, and IT decision-makers, guiding them through business transformation enabled by DataSnipper.

  • Drive Business Transformation: Help customers reimagine their workflows and processes, demonstrating how DataSnipper’s AI-powered capabilities can deliver measurable efficiency gains, cost savings, and quality improvements across audit and finance functions.

Our Systems Integration Team is seeking a Model-Based Systems Engineer to build the tools and framework we use to design the systems that operate our VIO and QPU technology. This role is focused on establishing QuantWare’s MBSE methodology and turning knowledge from cryogenics, wiring, control electronics and software into a single, executable system model. You will define how we model our systems and build the libraries, analyses and integrations that make the model useful day to day. Working closely with processor, hardware and software teams, you will play an important role in enabling the design of the large-scale quantum computers built around VIO-powered QPUs. We are hiring a Senior Director, International Affairs to join our Strategy team.</p> <p><strong>Position Description</strong></p> <p>Oklo is seeking a Senior Director of International Affairs to develop international opportunities that can materially advance the company's long-term strategy. This role connects market choices, senior relationships, sovereign and government capital, industrial partnerships, and selected cross-border initiatives.</p> <p>You will help determine where Oklo should engage, which institutions matter, and what a credible partnership or investment proposition should look like. The scope extends across the company's businesses and strategic priorities, rather than being limited to individual international reactor deployment projects.</p> <p>You will report to the Chief of Strategy Officer and work directly with the CSO on assigned initiatives. You will coordinate closely with the CFO organization, Government Affairs, Legal, technical and regulatory leaders, and business-unit teams, with explicit agreement on market coverage, counterpart relationships, and execution responsibilities.</p> <p>This person must reside in either the United Kingdom or the Netherlands.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Specific responsibilities may include:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Target markets and partnerships. </strong>Develop recommendations on priority markets, institutions, and opportunities based on strategic fit, partner capabilities, commercial demand, capital availability, timing, and risk.</li> <li><strong>Sovereign and institutional relationships. </strong>Build and advance relationships with sovereign investors, government institutions, industrial partners, and other organizations relevant to Oklo's global strategy.</li> <li><strong>Structure international opportunities. </strong>Develop business cases and proposed structures for international partnerships, sovereign or government-capital opportunities, joint ventures, and other cross-border initiatives.</li> <li><strong>Advance transactions. </strong>Work with Finance, Business Development, Corporate Development, Strategic Partnerships, and Legal to test economics, assess counterparties, develop terms, and advance approved opportunities toward executable agreements.</li> <li><strong>Navigate regulatory and policy dependencies. </strong>Coordinate with Government Affairs and technical, regulatory, and legal specialists on political, policy, licensing, export, and other dependencies that affect an opportunity's feasibility.</li> <li><strong>Lead initiative execution. </strong>Lead assigned initiatives across internal teams and outside advisers, maintaining clear objectives, owners, milestones, and decisions through launch or handoff.</li> <li><strong>Prepare and represent leadership. </strong>Prepare senior leadership for important international engagements and represent Oklo when delegated; work with the Strategy Associate on research, analysis, and materials and the Strategy Manager on coordinated follow-through.</li> <li><strong>Align cross-functional stakeholders. </strong>Align engagement plans with existing international and business-unit owners, avoid conflicting commitments, and recommend where to advance, defer, or decline an opportunity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in international business, strategic investing, government, industrial partnerships, or a related field, with evidence of delivering outcomes across institutions and jurisdictions.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to develop substantive relationships with senior government, commercial, or financial counterparties and translate engagement into concrete opportunities</li> <li>Strong commercial and financial judgment, including the ability to evaluate partnership economics, business cases, and potential capital structures.</li> <li>Experience leading cross-functional work while drawing on appropriate technical, legal, policy, and financial expertise.</li> <li>Excellent writing and cross-cultural communication, sound discretion, and the ability to make practical recommendations from incomplete information.</li> <li>Must reside in the UK or the Netherlands.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with sovereign investors, development finance, government-backed capital, or cross-border industrial ventures.</li> <li>Exposure to nuclear energy, the fuel cycle, infrastructure, advanced technology, or other strategically important industries.</li> <li>Experience connecting government and commercial objectives; relevant regional expertise or additional language capabilities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Competencies</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Director, International Affairs that is:</p> <ul> <li>Able to connect geopolitical and institutional context to specific commercial choices</li> <li>Able to build durable trust while maintaining clear objectives and realistic commitments</li> <li>Able to work effectively across cultures, disciplines, and organizations with different incentives</li> <li>Can distinguish meaningful strategic progress from access, visibility, or meeting volume</li> <li>Passionate about clean energy&nbsp;</li> <li>Passionate about making advanced fission a reality</li> <li>Willing and able to learn quickly</li> <li>Highly strategic and a forward-looking thinker</li> <li>An entrepreneurial mindset with comfort operating in ambiguity</li> <li>An exceptional communicator, negotiator, and has relationship-building skills</li> <li>Contains a strong executive presence and cross-functional leadership ability</li> <li>Aware of global perspectives with awareness of geopolitical and macroeconomic trends</li> <li>Passionate for building transformational infrastructure businesses</li> <li>Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us</li> <li>Willing to think differently and do things in new ways&nbsp;</li> <li>Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment</li> <li>Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before&nbsp;</li> <li>Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems</li> <li>An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!</li> <li>Able to communicate technical content and results verbally&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who you are:</strong></p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">A startup person</span>: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.</p> <p><u>Motivated</u>: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.</p> <p><u>A team-player</u>: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.</p> <p><u>An excellent communicator</u>: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.</p> <p><u>Creative</u>: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.</p> <p><u>Detail-oriented</u>: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">#CHOP: Oklo’s Values</strong><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Collaboration</strong>: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through&nbsp; to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.<br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Pathfinding</strong>: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.</span></p> <h3 data-start="82" data-end="118"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong data-start="86" data-end="118">Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer</strong></span></h3> <p data-start="120" data-end="326"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Zowel in de voorbereidende als de uitvoerende fase zorg je ervoor dat het proces vloeiend blijft verlopen, ook bij langdurige integrale projecten. Je eigen netwerk zet je in om de dienstverlening van Waalpartners verder te profileren. Als projectleider ben je bovendien de spil in de ontwikkeling van zowel medewerkers als de organisatie. Dat doe je niet alleen: samen schop je ‘t verder. Je werkt nauw samen met het management en de overige projectleiders over offertes, de bureauplanning en kansen in de markt. Dit ben jij Je bent open, nieuwsgierig en staat als leidinggevende stevig in je schoenen. Je omgeving ziet je als collegiaal en je neemt verantwoordelijkheid over je project en de ontwikkeling van de projectteamleden. Dit bieden wij jou Een salaris tussen €4.500 – €6.900 bruto o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Groeipad. Met onze Waalacademy bouw je stevig aan je eigen ontwikkeling. Flexibele werktijden. Kom je liever om half 8 binnen, in plaats van half 9? Geen probleem. Hybride werken. We zien je graag op kantoor, omdat we veel met elkaar en onze opdrachtgevers overleggen en samenwerken. Natuurlijk is er ook ruimte om thuis te werken, daarom mag je 2 dagen per week vanuit huis werken (o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband). 27 vakantiedagen Resultaatafhankelijke winstdeling. Draaien we samen een goed jaar? Dan profiteer jij daar ook van! Een goede pensioenregeling onder het oude pensioenstelsel. Een elektrische auto van de zaak, die je ook privé mag gebruiken Plezier. We werken niet alleen aan de ontwikkeling van onze omgeving en onszelf, maar hebben ‘t ook leuk met elkaar. Onze personeelsvereniging organiseert regelmatig activiteiten, we gaan samen op citytrip of een paar kilometer hardlopen. Dit breng jij mee Je hebt de drive om een project voor alle belanghebbenden tot een goed einde te brengen. Jij vindt het belangrijk om jezelf, samen met je collega’s, te blijven ontwikkelen. Je hebt een civieltechnische opleiding (hbo werk- en denkniveau). Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en kunt jezelf goed verwoorden: In gesprek en op papier. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence. We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who enjoys building clean, reliable interfaces between components and working where software meets hardware, and who takes ownership of making complex systems work together end to end. As a Senior Integration Software Engineer, you will support their integration into operational systems: connecting algorithms to the backend through robust APIs, building data connectors, health reporting and control software, and defining and verifying integrations with Command and Control (C2) systems. You will work closely with domain experts in acoustics, signal processing and machine learning, and with the software engineering team, and hands-on with our monitoring systems at our headquarters and production facility. You will also take technical ownership of work delivered by internal and external engineers and set the standard for good engineering practices. Key Responsibilities Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably. Willingness to work primarily from our Amsterdam headquarters, as parts of the role involve classified information and physical systems. Nice to Have: Knowledge of defense systems or defense standards (e.g. NATO STANAGs, MIL-STD), for example in naval, maritime security or surveillance systems. Experience with the scientific Python stack (e.g. NumPy, SciPy) or integrating signal processing or ML models into production systems. description: Over ons Europa verandert. Steeds meer mensen kiezen voor vrijheid — als zzp'er, freelancer of ondernemer. Ze bepalen zelf wanneer, hoe en met wie ze werken. We're doing it differently.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France, Germany and Ireland, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.


What you’ll own in your first year

You won’t inherit a finished product shelf. You’ll build the engine that fills it.

  1. Build the product engine. Turn how we benchmark a market into a system: compare cover, limits and exclusions across local players, our Dutch home product and our other markets, so every new product starts from facts, not gut feeling.
  2. Make the call on cover. Decide what we cover, what we don’t and who we insure, and turn it into a proposal. The tools do the comparison; the judgment is yours.
  3. Get it signed. Take the proposal to our risk carriers and negotiate it. You know what to push on, what to let go and which clause will set off six red flags.
  4. Get it live. Adapt our wordings to each new market, run the legal review and launch. Less writing from scratch, more making one strong product fit the next market. Then track loss ratios, competition and customer feedback, and sharpen it.
  5. Build what doesn’t exist yet. In the markets where we double down, own custom products from the insurance side, including cover for the trades and businesses others decline.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in the UK

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

  • Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts
  • Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident
  • Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives
  • Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal
  • Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara's investigation processes, with proficiency in Python
  • Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis
  • Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams
  • Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux
  • Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews
  • Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services
  • Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.
  • This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team

An ideal candidate also has:

  • 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience
  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification
  • Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. raw.description:
Are you interested in working with a leading education technology player, the global leader in the assessment and certification of professional skills industry with presence in more than 200 countries worldwide? If so, this is the chance to apply now! 📥

Shape the future of PRINCE2. The home of modern projects, programme, and portfolio management.

PeopleCert is looking for a Product Manager to help take our PRINCE2 portfolio of Best Practice to the next level of success - developing compelling propositions for globally recognised PRINCE2 products that ensure wide adoption among senior audiences, new sectors and markets. You will be responsible for the day-to-day management of key products in the PRINCE2 portfolio – including certifications, official publications and learning materials – making sure they remain high quality, relevant and well supported in market.

As Product Manager for the PRINCE2 portfolio, you will work closely with teams across the business in order to support delivery of the overall roadmap and enable commercial success for your product set within the PRINCE2 portfolio.

As Product Manager PRINCE2 your tasks will be the following:

Product strategy and vision

  • Contribute to the product vision and strategy, and develop and maintain the roadmap for your product set.
  • Conduct market research and analysis to identify trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape that will inform the product strategy.
  • Track agreed product goals and KPIs, and recommend actions to improve performance.

Product management

  • Monitor and analyze product performance, making data-driven recommendations to optimize and enhance your products.
  • Prioritise maintenance and improvement activities for your in-market products, to ensure continued relevance and positive customer experience.

New product development

  • Work proactively and collaboratively with teams across the business to ensure all aspects of product development, launch and in-market support are considered early in the business case and product design phase
  • Support the successful development and launch of new or updated products
  • Participate in all aspects of Product design, including: persona development; full end-to-end user journeys; service blueprints; key content and technical specifications
  • Design and manage the testing strategy for all products in development, to ensure they are consistently meeting the needs of our target audiences

Stakeholder collaboration

  • Contribute key elements to the go-to-market plans developed by Marketing, including positioning, key messaging and more.
  • Contribute to pricing proposals for your product set by providing market, competitor and partner insight, and supporting the relevant internal teams in pricing decisions.
  • Engage with internal and external stakeholders to secure buy-in and understanding of the product vision.

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in a Product Manager or Product Owner role in one of the following sectors: education, training, professional qualifications (e.g. ACA / CIPD etc.)
  • Knowledge of PeopleCert best practices and ideally familiar with PRINCE2 or other similar PPM (project, programme and portfolio) certification products.
  • Proven track record of managing multiple products and delivering successful outcomes.
  • Demonstrable experience of managing products through their whole lifecycle
  • Familiarity with all elements of product development, from discovery to delivery
  • Proven ability to evaluate product feedback objectively, and propose solutions to address business needs
  • Strong business/commercial acumen
  • Excellent people and management skills to interact with colleagues, cross-functional teams, and third parties around the world
  • Problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
  • Prior exposure in Education, Consulting, Examination/Certification, or Technology sectors will be considered an asset.
  • Excellent command of the English language (C2 level certification desired; LanguageCert C2 LTE or C2 IESOL a plus).
  • Advanced computer literacy required; ECDL Advanced certification desirable. Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics CRM or equivalent software will be considered an added advantage.

What we offer:

  • The opportunity to shape globally recognized frameworks used by professionals around the world.
  • A collaborative, high-impact international team and a purpose-driven working culture.
  • Flexible working conditions (location and hours).
  • Two free vouchers for all certifications from PeopleCert's Portfolio per year for all employees
  • Competitive compensation and personal development opportunities.
  • A global network of professionals and subject matter experts.

If you want to become a member of our international, dynamic and agile team that creates world leading software products, then we should certainly like to hear from you!

About PeopleCert

PeopleCert is a global leader in assessment and certification of professional skills, partnering with multi-national organizations and government bodies for the development & delivery of standardized exams. Delivering exams across 200 countries and in 25 languages over its state-of-the-art assessment technology, PeopleCert enables professionals to boost their careers and realize their life ambitions.

Quality, Innovation, Passion, Integrity, Clarity, and Velocity are the core values which guide everything we do.

Our offices in UK, Greece, and Cyprus boast a culture of diversity, where everyone is different, yet everyone fits in. All of us at PeopleCert are committed to the reflection of the diversity and inclusion of our customers and the communities in which we do business.

Working on Home Office (HO) Secure English Language Tests (SELTs)

Any person who is engaged by PeopleCert to work on the SELT service must undergo a Background Check (the results of which must be acceptable to PeopleCert and the HO) prior to commencing their SELT duties. All SELT personnel will be required to complete a declaration (provided by PeopleCert) where the existence of any criminal record and/or bankruptcy must be declared.

If working on the SELT service in the UK, background checks will include:

  • A basic or enhanced Disclosure Barring Service (DBS) check
  • Right to Work in the UK check (including nationality, identity and place of residence)
  • HO security check (Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) or Counter Terrorist Check (CTC)

  • If working on the SELT service anywhere in the world (outside of the UK) personnel will undergo background checks that are equivalent to those stated for the UK.

In addition, if personnel are required to speak to SELT candidates they must be appropriately skilled in English language and, where SELT services are provided anywhere in the world (outside of the UK), the official language of the relevant country.

All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. Experience translating complex payment rules, fee schedules or network requirements into system logic, configurations and controls. Commercial judgment and the ability to connect payment mechanics to pricing, product decisions and margin optimisation. Exceptional attention to detail and ownership, with the discipline required to manage complex rules where small errors can create meaningful financial impact at scale. Strong cross-functional execution, with the ability to work effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Data, Operations and external payment partners. Preferred Experience partnering directly with Visa, Mastercard or other payment networks. Experience applying AI or advanced analytics to rule interpretation, anomaly detection or payment-cost optimisation. You'll thrive here if You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it. You have experience at a fintech, payments company, or other highly regulated business. You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details. description: <div><strong>4PS is part of the Hilti Group</strong>, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. Be part of it.</h2> <p>Construction is one of the world's largest industries, and one of its least digitized. That is changing fast. At Hilti, we are not only developing software products - we are building and growing digital businesses around them. Hilti is at the centre of that shift, with a growing portfolio of software products that connect jobsites, offices, teams, and tools across the entire construction lifecycle. We are looking for ambitious, internationally mobile early-career talents with a global mindset who are excited about technology but see their future in business and leadership rather than in a purely technical software career.<br><br>The Software &amp; Digital Business Track of Hilti's Outperformer Program is a two-year accelerated development program that prepares you for a commercial, international leadership career in our software and digital businesses. You will learn how technology becomes customer value, how software businesses grow, how products are brought to market, and how commercial decisions are made. This is not a rotation program where you shadow senior leaders. From day one, you carry real responsibility.</p> <h2>What You'll do</h2> <p>The Software Track is designed to build the next generation of software business leaders at Hilti – Business Owners, Business Directors, Segment Managers and ultimately Senior Management Team members. If you want a structured path to running a business, this program is built for that outcome.<br><br>The program places you inside one of two business units:<br><br>Construction Software: Home to Fieldwire (Field Software for project and workforce management), ON!Track (asset management), and 4PS (construction business management). You will work directly with customers, product teams, and business leadership across Europe and beyond.<br><br>Fastening &amp; Protection Solutions: Where design &amp; engineering software for structural connections (e.g. PROFIS Engineering Suite), MEP supports and passive fire protection systems are developed and brought to market across a global customer base of structural and mechanical engineers.<br><br><br>For the Construction Software business unit, the program is structured to provide a balanced foundation in customer and market exposure, software product understanding, and business experience, while giving you the opportunity to work with at least two software products during the program:</p> <ul> <li>​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month sales assignment, developing direct customer insight and understanding the business challenges addressed by our software solutions.</li> <li>​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each across product and business teams, including exposure to an international project.</li> </ul> <p>​For the Fastening &amp; Protection Solution business unit, the program provides exposure to product management , software development, exposure to customers and start-ups and international project experience:</p> <ul> <li>​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month product management assignment, building product understanding and market insight.</li> <li>​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each, involving international projects that broaden your business perspective and global exposure.</li> </ul> <p>You will have a dedicated senior mentor from the start, direct exposure to executive leadership, and a peer cohort of Global Trainees across all Hilti business tracks globally.</p> <h2>What You’ll Bring</h2> <p>You are close to graduating or have recently completed a Master's degree - your degree is likely to be in construction management, civil engineering, or mechanical engineering with a focus on construction, Computer Science, or also Business study programs with an affinity for Software and construction. What matters more than your degree subject is the combination of traits below:</p> <ul> <li>Global mobility - you are willing and able to relocate internationally, multiple times. A global thinker who is keen for diverse cultural experiences.</li> <li>Digital and AI orientation - you think natively in digital workflows, comfortable with software tools, and know the power and potential of AI.</li> <li>Language - you are fluent in English and/or German, Dutch, French, Spanish or Italian. </li> <li>Commercial instinct - you are drawn to how businesses grow, how customers make decisions, and how products create.</li> <li>Low ego, high drive - you take the work seriously and yourself lightly. You seek feedback, move fast, and are energised by ambiguity rather than unsettled by it.</li> <li>You are at the start of your career and have maximum three years of junior work experience.</li> </ul> <h2>What’s In It for You</h2> <p>​​Show us what you can do, and in return, we promise you the experience of a lifetime. We offer you a transformative journey filled with learning, growth, and invaluable experiences that will shape your perspective and personal and professional development. On top of that, you’ll also take part in some fascinating courses and events:</p> <ul> <li>Introductory Global Summit: Experience 4 days at our global headquarters in Liechtenstein, featuring the presence of our Executive Board and Global Senior Leadership. The summit offers a comprehensive overview of our business, while fostering soft skill development and meaningful collaboration with fellow program participants.</li> <li>Social Project Summit: 7 days dedicated to building a better future, with contribution to a hands-on, high-impact community project. This experience offers the chance to immerse yourself in a different culture while actively improving living conditions for those in need.</li> <li>Leadership Summit: An enriching learning journey in partnership with a renowned business school, featuring online modules and collaborative projects with fellow program participants. The experience concludes with a 5-day on-campus summit to deepen insights and to foster business and leadership skills.</li> </ul> <h2>Why Hilti</h2> <p>Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.<br><br>Learn more about our recruitment process: https://careers.hilti.group/en/candidate-interview-preparation/</p> <h2>Commitment to Inclusion</h2> <p>​​At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.<br><br>​Exciting software journey: You will dive into the fast-paced world of our construction software business, gaining exposure to innovative digital solutions that are transforming one of the world's largest industries.<br>​<br>​Global cross-team collaboration: You will work with colleagues worldwide and get guidance from a dedicated mentor as you grow in your career.<br><br>​We hire for a career, not for a position. If you are looking for long-term career prospects and opportunities to grow, this is the perfect start.​<br><br>​Are you ready to jumpstart your career? Our hiring process is designed to help you showcase your skills and experience. The process has multiple steps and requires a longer period of time:</p> <ul> <li>It all starts with your application and a video interview.</li> <li>Get connected with our HR team in an online interview.</li> <li>Get ready to flex your problem-solving muscles with our online Business Case Round.</li> <li>Impress our Business Line Managers with your presentation skills and insights during the next round.</li> <li>And, if you make it to the end, you'll receive an invitation to our Assessment Center.</li> </ul> <p>​Exciting, right? Let's get started!</p> <p><strong>4PS is part of the Hilti Group</strong>, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. Please submit your application directly via <a href="https://careers.hilti.group/de-ch/stellenangebote/19051-en/global-trainee-program-outperformer-software-business-track-m-f-x/">Hilti Careerpage</a>.<br><br>​The Assessment Center will take place in Liechtenstein at Hilti Headquarter on December 1st and 2nd, 2026. raw.title: Mid/Senior AI Cinematic Video Editor (Freelance - Full Remote - Netherlands)
raw.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

We are looking for a Mid/Senior AI Cinematic Video Editor who is deeply embedded in generative video workflows and can independently craft high-quality, narrative-driven content from concept to final output.

You are a sharp-eyed video editor comfortable operating at the intersection of creativity and emerging technology, building visually compelling long-form videos using AI-first pipelines. You take ownership of the entire production stack — from prompting and generation to editing, compositing, graphic design work and final delivery. You thrive in a high-performance environment where your quick wits and passion for story-telling shine.

Reporting to your Content Lead, this is what you'll be doing:


Key Responsibilities

  • Conceptualise scripts based on current production needs and centred around existing AI characters (our own IPs)

  • Create narrative-driven, longform video content, including stylized and explicit NSFW visuals, with a strong focus on storytelling, atmosphere, and visual coherence throughout

  • Own and manage end-to-end AI video production workflows, from ideation and prompting to generation, editing, and post-production

  • Utilise tools such as Kling, Seedance, Happy Horse and other AI video models/platforms to produce high-quality visual sequences

  • Develop and maintain consistent character appearance, style, and scene continuity across longer narratives using advanced techniques

  • Integrate motion graphic design and colour correction to deliver cohesive final outputs

  • Experiment rapidly with new AI models, tools, and techniques, incorporating them into production workflows and sharing skills with the rest of the team

  • Align with your Content Lead’s creative direction while maintaining a high degree of autonomy in execution and technical decision-making

  • Continuously refine workflows for efficiency, scalability, and output quality


Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

  • 4–6+ years of experience in video production, VFX, or digital art, with a strong portfolio (AI-driven video work is a must)

  • Hands-on experience with the latest AI video tools and models (e.g., Kling, Seedance, Happy Horse, and similar emerging options)

  • Solid understanding of AI image/video generation pipelines, including prompting, batching, consistency techniques, and post-processing

  • Experience with traditional tools like Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar for final assembly and polish

  • Strong grasp of visual storytelling, pacing, composition, and cinematic language

  • Ability to maintain character and scene consistency across sequences in AI-generated content


Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaboration skills (fluent in English)

🎯 High ownership — able to take ideas from concept to completion independently

⚡️ Experimental mindset — comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving tools

⏱️ Fast iteration cycles — able to test, fail, refine, and improve quickly

🧠 Curious and self-driven — constantly exploring new AI capabilities and workflows

🧢 Open to feedback and continuous improvement

🍭 #NSFW — Comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit adult content


Bonus Points

  • Experience in AI-native storytelling or filmmaking

  • Background in 3D, VFX, technical art or as a colourist

  • Familiarity with training/customizing models (LoRAs, embeddings, fine-tuning)

  • Prior experience in adult, dating, or adjacent creative industries a huge bonus

  • Experience with ComfyUI

  • Experience with Stable Diffusion / AUTOMATIC1111 and related tooling (Advanced prompting, working with trained LoRAs, refining, upscaling, inpainting etc.)

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

Compensation: $28K – $58K • Multiple Ranges

  • South America • $28K – $58K
  • Europe • €42K – €73K

title: IT Stage
description: Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende IT-stage waarin je jouw technische kennis in de praktijk kunt brengen én jezelf verder kunt ontwikkelen? Bij Cefetra in Rotterdam hebben we vanaf februari 2027 een stageplek beschikbaar voor een enthousiaste en leergierige IT-student. wie zijn wij? Cefetra Group bestaat uit verschillende handelsbedrijven die actief zijn binnen de agrarische sector en de voedingsingrediëntenindustrie, waaronder toonaangevende merken binnen de ingrediëntenmarkt. Samen hebben we ongeveer 800 medewerkers, verspreid over 39 kantoren in 17 landen wereldwijd. We werken nauw met elkaar samen om onze klanten de best mogelijke service te bieden. Samen met onze leveranciers bouwen we sterke supply chains en creëren we waarde door grondstoffen in te kopen en te leveren aan de internationale voedingsmiddelen-, diervoedings- en energiesector. Bekijk hier onze corporate video . De stage Als IT Support Stagiair(e) word je onderdeel van het IT-team en ondersteun je collega’s bij hun dagelijkse IT-vragen. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor gebruikers en helpt bij het oplossen van technische problemen, zowel op afstand als op kantoor. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van hoe IT-support binnen een internationale organisatie werkt. Tijdens je stage houd je je onder andere bezig met: Het bieden van eerstelijns IT-support en oplossen van hardware-, software- en netwerkproblemen; Het beheren van gebruikersaccounts, wachtwoorden, licenties en apparaten; Het installeren, configureren en uitgeven van laptops en mobiele telefoons; Het registreren en opvolgen van incidenten en aanvragen via het ticketsysteem. Daarnaast werk je samen met ervaren IT-specialisten aan projecten op het gebied van infrastructuur, werkplekbeheer en procesverbetering. Hierdoor ontwikkel je niet alleen je technische vaardigheden, maar leer je ook hoe IT een belangrijke bijdrage levert aan de dagelijkse werkzaamheden binnen een internationale handelsorganisatie. Tijdens je stage maak je ook kennis met de technologieën en systemen die binnen onze IT-omgeving worden gebruikt. Je werkt met Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, Intune en Windows Server voor het beheren van gebruikers, apparaten en applicaties. Daarnaast doe je ervaring op met Cisco Meraki voor netwerkbeheer, Citrix voor virtuele werkplekken en applicaties, VMware voor gevirtualiseerde serveromgevingen en TeamViewer voor ondersteuning op afstand. Zo krijg je een brede kijk op zowel moderne cloudoplossingen als traditionele IT-infrastructuur. Wie ben jij? Je bent nieuwsgierig, servicegericht en krijgt energie van het oplossen van technische uitdagingen. Je neemt initiatief, werkt graag samen met anderen en bent niet bang om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Daarnaast beschik je over analytisch en probleemoplossend vermogen, goede communicatieve vaardigheden en ben je flexibel en betrouwbaar. Idealiter herken je jezelf in het volgende: Je volgt momenteel een mbo-opleiding richting ICT, Informatica, Systeem- en Netwerkbeheer of een vergelijkbare opleiding; Je hebt affiniteit met IT-support en systeembeheer; Je bent leergierig en wilt graag praktijkervaring opdoen binnen een professionele IT-omgeving; Je beschikt over basiskennis van Windows, Microsoft 365 en netwerken; Je kunt zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werken; Je beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal goed. Wat bieden wij? Een unieke kans om ervaring op te doen binnen een snelgroeiende, internationale organisatie. Zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid staan centraal binnen onze bedrijfscultuur. Wij bieden: Een uitdagende stage binnen een internationale organisatie; Begeleiding door ervaren IT-professionals; Veel ruimte om te leren en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen; Werken met moderne technologieën en professionele IT-omgevingen; Een stagevergoeding van €525 per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband; Deelname aan Young Cefetra-activiteiten; Een prachtig kantoor in het centrum van Rotterdam, met uitzicht op de Maas en de Erasmusbrug. Interesse? Ben jij klaar om jouw IT-kennis in de praktijk te brengen en ervaring op te doen binnen een internationale organisatie? Solliciteer dan hieronder en we nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op. Heb je vragen? Neem dan contact op met Jur Lemmers via +31 6 2520 3984 of Werving- en selectiebureaus? We waarderen de interesse, maar we werven al onze kandidaten rechtstreeks. We begrijpen dat u uw kandidaten graag voor onze interessante functies wilt voorstellen, maar dit past niet binnen de manier waarop wij ons wervingsproces hebben ingericht. Dit betekent dat alle ongevraagd aangeboden profielen worden beschouwd als rechtstreekse sollicitaties op onze vacatures. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
